crossRefs.note: Yahweh is in his holy temple. Yahweh is on his throne in heaven. His eyes observe. His eyes examine the children of men.
Behold, he puts no trust in his servants. He charges his angels with error.
Behold, he puts no trust in his holy ones. Yes, the heavens are not clean in his sight;
Above him stood the seraphim. Each one had six wings. With two he covered his face. With two he covered his feet. With…
For though Yahweh is high, yet he looks after the lowly; but he knows the proud from afar.

translations.web: Who stoops down to see in heaven and in the earth?
translations.bsb: He humbles Himself to behold the heavens and the earth.
translations.kjv: Who humbleth himself to behold the things that are in heaven, and in the earth!
translations.asv: That humbleth himself to behold The things that are in heaven and in the earth?
